info.title: new-sdd-workspace — scaffold an FS.GG workspace (SDD + Rendering + optional
info.description: FS.GG workspace scaffolder — composes a selectable Standard or Typed SDD lifecycle, a runnable provider workspace, and an optional Governance overlay in one command, with a rich Spectre.Console progress UI. Orchestrates existing published machinery; no FS.GG.Templates checkout required.

commands.name: retrofit
commands.description: idempotently wire coordination ONTO an existing

options.name: --template
options.description:
provider/template (default: rendering; omitted for
compatibility)
rendering, console, web, fable-game, fable-bindings

options.name: --lifecycle
options.description: none, sdd, typed-sdd, spec-kit (legacy/frozen)

options.name: --profile
options.description:
rendering-only profile (default: game = provider default)
game, app, headless-scene, governed, sample-pack

options.name: --npm-package
options.description: fable-bindings package name (requires --npm-version)

options.name: --binding-target
options.description: universal

options.name: --ref
options.description:
FS.GG.Templates ref for the descriptor (default: main =
newest)

options.name: --board
options.description:
coordination board to wire the workspace to (default:
FS-GG/Coordination)

options.name: --repo
options.description:
this workspace's own repo (its board identity +
chore-lock basis)

options.name: --public-board
options.description: request a public-readable product Project (requires

options.name: --trusted-writers
options.description:
allowlist
--verified-base-permission READ and --verified-exclusive-writers <ids> record
both Manage access facts after re-validating observable Project facts
secure <workspace> --project <owner/title> --trusted-writers <ids>

options.name: --private-board
options.description: request a private product Project

options.name: --chore-locks
options.description:
FSGG_COORD_CHORE_LOCKS for a non-FS-GG board
(owner/repo#n,… — comma-separated)

options.name: --no-coordination
options.description:
skip wiring the workspace to a coordination board (no kit,
no env)

options.name: --pinned
options.description:
skip the pre-scaffold fsgg-sdd self-update (scaffold with
the installed CLI)
default: self-update to the newest coherent set first; pair
--pinned with --ref <tag> for a reproducible scaffold

options.name: --upgrade
options.description:
also run `fsgg-sdd upgrade` after scaffolding (reconcile an
existing project)

options.name: --no-governance
options.description:
skip the governance overlay
Run with no arguments on an interactive terminal to build the invocation with
prompts.

commands.name: scaffold-provenance.json
commands.description:
secure --repo <owner/repo>  apply and verify collaborator-only repository
issue intake
secure <workspace> --project <owner/title> (--public-board|--private-board)
--trusted-writers <ids>
secure <workspace> --project <owner/title> --trusted-writers <ids>
--verified-base-permission READ --verified-exclusive-writers <ids>
apply/re-read observable Project visibility and writers;
retain base-Read human verification
